result: 8 GiB Pi 4B raw image candidate built with full-size RedSea /Home and /Tmp, bounded FileWrite create/replace, and DirMake support. Builder layout, boot payload, RedSea geometry/root bitmap, source-bank headers, and FAT payload read-back checks passed. Physical microSD was not written.

boot.contents: Raspberry Pi UEFI firmware files and ZealOS boot payload

zealos_data.contents: Full-size RedSea volume with /Home and /Tmp, followed by two 32 MiB append-only source banks

checks: scripts/check-pi-desktop-image.py passed native/recovery ELF identity, load bounds and relocations, two-entry boot chain, and source-module validation.
The image builder verified the merged FAT32 boot payload with mtools read-back.
The image builder verified MBR partition extents, RedSea geometry/root bitmap, and both source-bank headers.
make check-pi4-platform passed, including simulated SDHCI single-sector writes, flush, and read-back; this is host simulation, not a physical Pi test.
known_scope: This is a host-built raw image; it has not been flashed to physical microSD or booted on a Pi.
The runtime requires an explicit psdopen before normal writes.
Physical Pi SDHCI write, flush, zput/zload read-back, cold-boot persistence, and preservation of the FAT boot partition remain unverified.
RedSea delete, rename, and automatic directory growth are not implemented.
General writable USB-storage support and a Pi-bootable USB installer are not included.
The source tree and payload include uncommitted working-tree changes.
